description:
Solo participant building "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" — 
an interactive simulation where students manage a lunar/Mars outpost, 
balancing life support, radiation shielding, power, and food production. 
Open to collaborators interested in AI, web development, or game design.
summary: Mars: Outpost Alpha is a browser-based 3D mission game in which players guide a crew through a ten-Sol Mars outpost campaign. Players inspect habitat and power systems, manage oxygen, water, food, and energy, grow crops, explore with a rover, collect samples, and respond to a dust storm. Their decisions affect colony resources, crew readiness, and mission outcomes. The game introduces mission ideas through guided objectives and a field guide, using plain-language explanations for terms such as Sol, radiation, oxygen, and water. A Journal activity uses archived measurements from NASA’s Curiosity rover Radiation Assessment Detector to frame a radiation-planning choice. The game simplifies some systems for play; its resource values and wellness effects are not predictions of a real Mars mission.
details:
Mars: Outpost Alpha is a browser-based 3D game about helping a four-person crew run a Mars outpost over ten sols. Players inspect and maintain the habitat, solar array, and greenhouse; grow crops; explore with a rover; collect samples; and make choices through the Journal. They monitor oxygen, water, food, power, and crew wellbeing as they work toward each sol’s objectives.

The systems affect one another: crops need water and power, dust storms reduce solar output, and repairs also use resources. If a critical resource reaches zero, the mission fails and the game explains which resource ran out. A first-play guide, field guide, and objective prompts help younger players understand terms and find their next task.

The game includes archived radiation information from NASA’s Curiosity rover RAD instrument. The resource changes, storm effects, and crew-wellbeing outcomes are simplified for gameplay; they are not live readings or predictions for a real Mars mission. I built the game with React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, and Vite.
